title: components: the record page heading draws a widget-hinted nameField's stored value, not its face, so a record share's H1 is the recipient's raw user id
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a user-visible defect on a served view, with a named landing. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 of objectstack-ai/objectstack (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-support-ai` · `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`, as one of the two console rules named by the seat ruling on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24701 (`6282390889`). That ruling's code landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24831 (merge `99e4eaa227`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it to the lane that owns the record page header (`packages/components`, `page:header`).

## What happens

- `sys_record_share` declares `nameField: 'recipient_id'`. Since objectstack PR #24831, that field declares `widget: 'recipient-picker'` and `dependsOn: ['recipient_type']`, and the face names a user id by the row's kind.
- The record page heading draws `recordDisplayValueAt(data, declaredNameField(schema))`, the stored text, and never consults a widget face. So a record share's H1 is a raw user id. The maintainer's HotCRM pass measured this (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24701, comment `6283814156`).
- The record is read whole, so its `recipient_type` is present. The face has what it needs; the heading does not use it.

## Where (read at objectstack's console pin `.objectui-sha` `12dc7b47c3`, by code)

- `page:header` (`containers.tsx`) draws the declared `nameField`'s stored value through `recordDisplayValueAt`, with no widget-face rung. The same heading already special-cases a select `nameField`'s option label (objectui#13103).

**Expected:** when the declared `nameField` carries a widget whose cell face names a value (here `recipient-picker`), the heading draws it through that face. The rule is driven by the declaration. ⛔ No name-to-label mapping in the console.

## Dedupe

objectui, MCP `search_issues`, open and closed, "record page header H1 draws nameField stored value ignoring widget face recipient-picker raw id": 23 hits.
- objectui#13103 (closed) is the select `nameField`'s option label.
- objectui#13116 (closed) is a list fetching the `nameField`.
- Neither covers a widget face on the heading. **New.**

Dedupe words: record heading widget face; nameField recipient-picker H1; header raw id widget hint.
